ios.desc:
The reCAPTCHA app from Google helps you securely verify you’re a human on websites and applications that have integrated the new reCAPTCHA mobile verification experience.
When you encounter a reCAPTCHA QR code or a reCAPTCHA mobile verification button on a supported site or app, you can use this app for a smoother verification experience.
Features:
*   Seamless Verification: Quickly prove you're human.
*   App Clip: For even faster, on-demand verification without installing the full app, simply scan a reCAPTCHA QR code or tap a reCAPTCHA verification button to launch the App Clip.
*   Enhanced Security: Leverage your device's capabilities to securely verify you're a human.
How the App Clip Works:
1.  Scan a compatible reCAPTCHA QR code using the Camera app on your phone or tap a verification button on a website or app on your phone.
2.  The reCAPTCHA App Clip appears.
3.  Complete the verification within the App Clip.
4.  Continue seamlessly on the original website or app.
